title: store.DOMAINS declares less than the writers write; the debug ring's loader drops rows with an unpriced sample
claim: A sample the coordinator writes with predicted_cost None (no price covered the interval, #2229) is outside DOMAINS (admitted=0), so debugger._kept refuses each debugger.cycle_row row that carries it: 0 of 192 rows kept for the synthetic bundle's production-written samples; and on the owner's real download 102 healthy fields its loaders read intact are off their declaration (off_restore 1, snapshots 101).
mechanism: DOMAINS['accuracy']['accuracy/samples/#/predicted_cost'] is _R (non-null) while AccuracySample.as_dict writes None and actual_cost beside it is _N; 'rows/#/accuracy_sample' aliases that table and debugger._repair drops a row admitted() refuses, so the ring loses those rows on the next load (restart). The same drift without a dropping reader: off_restore 'armed/*' is declared a number while its writer stores {entity_id, value} and _entry_of reads that mapping; the snapshot ring keeps the pre-R10-HOTFIX-COP-UNMEASURED learner keys cop_baseline/cop_health_cusum, which DOMAINS neither declares nor marks unread. The stores self-test (debugger.store_report) reports these as off-domain on a healthy install.

evidence.value: sample_none_cost_admitted=0, unit_row_kept=0/1, synthetic_written_rows_kept=0/192 (192/192 unpriced), real off_domain[off_restore]=1 with loader keeping 2/2, real off_domain[snapshots]=101
evidence.machine: macOS arm64, box B8 (shared), CI venv python3

perturbation.change: --declare: in memory, DOMAINS accuracy samples' predicted_cost nullable (as actual_cost is) and off_restore's armed entry declared as its writer's mapping

null_control.note: the real install priced every interval in the window, so its rows are kept either way: the drop needs an unpriced interval, which the synthetic install's store shows the coordinator writing

metric_definition: Rows debugger._kept keeps of rows debugger.cycle_row writes from a bundle's restored accuracy samples; store.off_domain field count per store document.
phenomenon_property: Every field a current or still-on-disk release's writer produces is declared in store.DOMAINS, in its domain or marked unread, so no reader that consults DOMAINS (admitted, _repair, the stores self-test) refuses healthy data.
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D15/s1/store_replay.py --bundle B (each store with off_domain>0 over a production-written bundle is a seam; then grep -n 'admitted(' custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/*.py for the readers that drop on it)
proposed_fix_scope: store.py DOMAINS: predicted_cost -> _N; off_restore 'armed/*/entity_id' and 'armed/*/value' beside the scalar; the snapshot ring's legacy thermal_learning keys declared with unread= naming the provenance rule. A regression arm driving debugger.cycle_row with an unpriced sample through _kept.
